key_insight: Phase-aware cost estimation helps massively parallel safe reinforcement learning preserve episode-level safety constraints despite short training rollouts.
engineering_relevance: The method enables faster wall-clock training while accounting for the mismatch between short rollout batches and full-episode safety costs.
method: Model staggered environment resets as a phase-mixture distribution and analyze phase-coverage bias.
Aggregate costs across rollout phases to estimate full-episode costs.
Tighten constraints to account for finite-sample uncertainty and distribution mismatch within on-policy optimization.
evidence_signal: Experiments using an MJX-based Safety Gym implementation report performance comparable to non-massively parallel implementations with substantially reduced wall-clock training time.
watch_item: Cost-estimation reliability depends on phase coverage; the abstract does not quantify safety violations or speedup.
paper_title: Accelerating Safe Reinforcement Learning with Massive Parallelism
